Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

hours of incident resolution.", "output": "Team, here is our urgent operational guidance for handling the database replication desynchronization incident. Under no circumstances should any engineer manually restart primary database nodes. Do not trigger automated failover scripts until the replica log position is fully verified, and even after verifying log position, do not trigger them without explicit approval from the lead database administrator. Never execute DROP TABLE or TRUNCATE commands on staging or production clusters during the active incident. First, inspect replication delay metrics in pg_stat_replication on the primary PostgreSQL instance. Second, check WAL receiver connection logs in postgresql.log on standby replica nodes in us-west-2. Third, increase the replication timeout from 60 seconds to 120 seconds in recovery.conf. Fourth, verify that the network link between us-east-1 and us-west-2 has zero packet loss and latency under 50 milliseconds. Fifth, do not resume analytical batch ingestion jobs until replication lag drops below 10 seconds. Site reliability engineers must monitor query queue depth on Datadog, keeping blocked queries below 20. Do not execute VACUUM FULL operations during active replication recovery under any circumstances. Never terminate Postgres backend worker processes using kill -9 to prevent shared memory corruption. Sixth, inspect WAL receiver buffer utilization in sysctl.conf ensuring network receive buffers are set to 16 MB. Seventh, verify that max_replication_slots in postgresql.conf is configured to 10 slots with active slot monitors on Datadog. Eighth, do not modify pg_hba.conf authentication rules until the network security team validates SSL client certificates. Ninth, run automated checksum verification on primary WAL segments ensuring zero corrupted blocks before replication catchup. The lead infrastructure architect requires continuous replication health checks exporting metrics every 15 seconds to Prometheus. The database reliability architect mandates that all manual troubleshooting steps are documented in real time on incident ticket INC-458. Do not disable SSL certificate verification between PostgreSQL nodes under any circumstances. Never bypass row level security policies during emergency database maintenance. Tenth, inspect PostgreSQL connection pool utilization in pgbouncer.ini ensuring client connections do not exceed 2000. Eleventh, verify that replication slot lag on Datadog remains below 100 MB. Do not allow non-admin database users to execute administrative functions during replication recovery. Do not enable synchronous replication on reporting read-only standby nodes under any circumstances. Never restart PgBouncer connection poolers without notifying database operations engineers. Twelfth, verify that disk I/O latency on NVMe volumes remains below 2 milliseconds. The engineering director requires a formal root cause analysis meeting scheduled within 24 hours of incident resolution."}]
